Elena —

Thanks — we can support this but want to be transparent about a couple of things up front. A few of our most relevant healthcare and fintech advocates have been fielded heavily in the last month and are in a voluntary "cooldown" period to avoid reference fatigue.

Options that would work this week:
- Two shorter 15-minute calls with mid-market fintech customers (can do demo + Q&A), or
- One 20-minute call + one written testimonial from a healthcare customer on a tight schedule (we can provide a redacted transcript), or
- Put a short standby list in place: we can pre-authorize 3 advocates who agree to take 15–20 minute calls within a 72-hour window; if one declines we rotate to the next.

I can coordinate logistics but will need a green light on either the standby approach or accepting a mix of written + live references.

I'll loop Ben for capacity planning and Marissa for any case-study considerations.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
